Whenever you generate code in this project, you MUST strictly follow Clean Code principles across all technologies (frontend, backend, mobile, DevOps, AI).

Rules to always follow:
- Use meaningful, self-explanatory variable, function, and class names.
- Follow SOLID principles and separation of concerns.
- Functions must be short and do only one thing.
- No magic numbers or hardcoded secrets.
- Proper error handling with clear messages.
- Avoid deep nesting; use early returns.
- Write reusable, testable, and maintainable code.
- Follow official style guides for the given technology.
- Use consistent formatting and lint-safe patterns.
- Add comments ONLY where the intent is not obvious.
- Never write hacky, temporary, or demo-quality code unless explicitly told.
- Prefer composition over inheritance.
- Optimize for readability first, performance second.

If any requested solution violates clean architecture or best practices, you must refactor it automatically before responding and clearly explain why.
